name: @hl-bos/barbershop
description: BarberOS — the shop's own application. The first surface a barbershop signs into and operates itself, rather than one Herman Legacy Digital drives on its behalf. Talks to HL-BOS Core only through the public.barberos_* API (migration 0056) as the signed-in user; never holds a service-role key and never reaches a schema PostgREST does not expose.
